answer:
Your Planets note now has a 3D solar system on its App side. The only check_app warning left is "no control sent an edit". That's expected, because the app only reads your table and never writes to it.

- **Spin and zoom:** Drag with your finger to spin it. Pinch (or scroll on a Mac) to zoom.
- **Planets:** Each one orbits the sun. Tap a planet, or one of the buttons under the scene, to see its distance, radius and day length.
- **Squashing:** Distance and radius both use square roots, so Jupiter and Saturn don't swamp Mercury and the whole system fits on screen. The sun is a fixed size and isn't scaled from the table. Each planet spins at a speed based on its day length, with the speed capped at both ends. Saturn has a ring.
- **Edits:** It reads the table directly, so adding Uranus or Neptune to the table adds them to the scene.

I couldn't see how it looks, because I only had the automatic checks and no screenshots. Tell me if anything looks off on your phone.
